title: Monarch Mirror FFN transform

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no MA-282 branch found; MA-274 and MA-278 branches belong to other workers

hypothesis: Four logical nonlinear FFNs related by a Monarch structured transform can share one physical FFN plus one scalar coordinate per task; unrelated FFNs require private parameters.
physical_object: One shared ReLU FFN with dimensions 8x12x8
mirror_coordinate: One float32 m per task controlling two block-diagonal Givens factors around a fixed shuffle permutation
controls: per-task IA3 hidden scaling fit on training examples
per-task rank-r output LoRA fit on training examples
task_family: Aligned teacher f_m(x)=ReLU(x T(m)^T W1) W2 T(m), T(m)=A1(m) P A2(m). A1 and A2 are block-diagonal 2x2 Givens rotations on four pairs with fixed angle multipliers and a fixed perfect-shuffle permutation P. Independent tasks use unrelated W1/W2 and unrelated context cues.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out task output MSE over methods and aligned/independent conditions; bytes and coordinate throughput are preregistered tie-breakers
development.lora_rank_selection: Average held-out MSE across both development worlds and both aligned/independent conditions; rank 4 selected (mean aligned 1.082671, independent 0.821937; ranks 1/2 were worse in both).

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.codec: binary tensor records charge field names, context IDs/codes, dtype, shape, all learned tensors and headers

success_gate: On every fresh aligned world, Mirror task MSE <=1e-5, actual payload <=0.5x independent full FFNs, and coordinate-path throughput >=0.5x the best matched simple control. Mirror-specific value additionally requires a better quality/byte/compute frontier than Monarch factors, IA3, LoRA and butterfly views.
failure_gate: Mirror misses an aligned quality/storage/runtime gate or is Pareto-dominated by a simpler structured/PEFT control.
boundaries: Synthetic ReLU FFN with four known tasks
Fixed operator screen, not trained capacity
Aligned teacher is generated from the Monarch view family

amendments.reason: Post-fresh code audit found the independent Monarch payload omitted the shared FFN it executes, and throughput replay used the shared-FFN path for several methods rather than each method’s actual inference path. The first fresh output is retained as invalid diagnostic evidence and excluded from all claims.
changes: Charge shared W1/W2 to independent Monarch view control.
Measure inference by replaying each serialized method’s actual frozen forward path; report per-example MAC proxy and prepared operator workspace.
Store low-rank LoRA factors as factors and evaluate genuine rank-r forward.
Fit IA3 gates by least squares on training-only examples.
Use new fresh seeds 28221–28223; no fitting or selection uses the invalidated fresh outcomes.

amendments.reason: A second audit found independent Monarch angles were charged but bypassed by the unrelated-condition inference branch. The first corrected fresh outputs are retained as invalid diagnostics and excluded.
changes: Always execute the charged per-task Monarch angle factors in the independent-Monarch control, including unrelated tasks.

amendments.reason: Audit found the aligned independent-full upper control used the untransformed common FFN weights and therefore did not exactly reconstruct its teacher. Outputs are retained as invalid diagnostics and excluded.
changes: For aligned teachers store each task’s equivalent independent FFN matrices W1_t=T(m_t)^T W1 and W2_t=W2 T(m_t), then execute those matrices.
